reentrancy_behavioral_v1.I1: превышение разрешённой выплаты; I2:: I1 checks excess payout; I2 checks consistency between payout and accounting; I3 checks conservation of financial flow; I5 checks whether assets back remaining recorded claims. I4 checks rollback and I6 checks permitted operations. These checks are not independent vulnerabilities and are not summed into a protection score.
reentrancy_behavioral_v1.В RE01 baseline повторное вычитание вызы: In the RE01 baseline, repeated subtraction wraps the uint256 credit. The huge M/D values reflect actual machine-state corruption, not a plausible monetary valuation; raw credit and measured excess payout are retained separately. In RE02, the aggregate can match actual ETH while differing from the sum of remaining credits; both are recorded. In RE02/RE03, a successful nested call under CEI yields no extra payout and is not rated below mutex rejection when the properties tie.

reentrancy_behavioral_v1.Ограничения: один заранее известный огра: Limitations: one previously known bounded reentry attempt, three sources, fixed amounts and gas budget, one local recipient, known prior results, and closed-storage reads through an explicit schema. The study does not prove full functional equivalence, protection against all forms of reentrancy, or real-world prevention probability. Other functions, cross-function reentry, depth/gas boundaries, and live networks were not tested.
